Package org.lightsleep.database

Class Standard

java.lang.Object
org.lightsleep.database.Standard
All Implemented Interfaces:
Database
Direct Known Subclasses:
MariaDB, MySQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQLite, SQLServer
public class Standard extends Object implements Database
A database handler that does not depend on the particular DBMS.

The object of this class has a TypeConverter map with the following additional TypeConverter to TypeConverter.typeConverterMap.

    • maxStringLiteralLength

      public final int maxStringLiteralLength
      Maximum length of string literal when generates SQL.

      If the string literal exceeds this length, it generated as SQL parameters (?).
      The value of maxStringLiteralLength of lightsleep.properties has been set. (if undefined, 128)

    • maxBinaryLiteralLength

      public final int maxBinaryLiteralLength
      Maximum length of binary literal when generates SQL.
